title: Under-display camera image enhancement via cascaded curve estimation
authors: Jun Luo, Wenqi Ren, Tao Wang, Chongyi Li, Xiaochun Cao

details.作者: Jun Luo, Wenqi Ren, Tao Wang, Chongyi Li, Xiaochun Cao
details.简介: The new trend of full-screen devices encourages manufacturers to position a camera behind a screen, i.e., the newly-defined Under-Display Camera (UDC). Therefore, UDC image restoration has been a new realistic single image enhancement problem. In this work, we propose a curve estimation network operating on the hue (H) and saturation (S) channels to perform adaptive enhancement for degraded images captured by UDCs. The proposed network aims to match the complicated relationship between the images captured by under-display and display-free cameras. To extract effective features, we cascade the proposed curve estimation network with sharing weights, and we introduce a spatial and channel attention module in each curve estimation network to exploit attention-aware features.
